cards.def: On his first night in Heorot, Grendel seized thirty sleeping men and carried them back to his lair.
Grendel terrorized Heorot for twelve winters, long enough for news of Hrothgar's sorrow to spread across the world.
Beowulf sailed with fourteen hand-picked companions, making a band of fifteen Geats.
Sailors reported that Beowulf had the strength of thirty men in the grip of each hand, which is why Hrothgar hopes he can beat Grendel.
Unferth claims that Beowulf and Breca struggled in the sea for seven nights before Breca won.
Beowulf says that he and Breca swam side by side for five nights until storms drove them apart.
Beowulf says his sword killed nine sea monsters during the swim, which made the sea safe for sailors.
Wealhtheow gave Beowulf two arm bangles, a mail shirt, rings, and the finest gold torque the poet had ever heard of.
In 1731 a fire in the Cotton library scorched the Beowulf manuscript, which is why some of its lines are now damaged or lost.
The course dates the composition of Beowulf to the 8th to 10th century, making it the oldest long poem in English.
The action of Beowulf is set in Scandinavia before about 550, although the poem was written in England.
Each line of Old English verse has four strong stresses, two in each half-line, linked by alliteration rather than rhyme.
